measurement_note: Size is r, the Scores row count. The 32/128/256 tiers span 8x and place every chronologically distinct exam in one student-subject group. The accepted query groups once and performs two keyed endpoint joins. A correct materialized all-pairs baseline creates Theta(r^2) rows and must fail only scaling.
